Slots for [brg_careers-hero]. Declared beside the fragment so a slot and its {token} ship in one commit. Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`; never hand-edit an acf.json. Slot names are underscore-only. Defaults are esc_html'd, so write literal characters, never `&` or `—`. THE

IS NOT WIRED: Whether the hero display headline should be an ACF field at all is Sean's design gate and is still open as of 2026-08-13 — Conti recommended wiring it, but a peer cannot grant a call the MANIFESTO puts at Sean's gate. THE SUB IS SPLIT AROUND ITS INLINE , not carried by one field. The closing phrase sits in a highlighted marker block. Same technique as community-give's lede and community-stats' label lines: keep the structural markup in the fragment and slot the text around it, so no field ever has to hold HTML. An `html`/wysiwyg slot would return

-wrapped content nested inside

. The space before the lives in the MARKUP because ACF trims on save — a default ending in a trailing space would silently lose it and the words would run together.

sub_1.label: Sub copy — before the highlight
sub_1.doc: Everything up to and including the em dash. The space before the highlight is in the markup, so no trailing space here.
sub_1.default: We're building careers here, not just filling shifts. If you're driven, hospitality-minded, and ready to grow —

sub_highlight.label: Sub copy — highlighted phrase
sub_highlight.doc: Sits in the yellow marker block that closes the sentence. Short — it is a highlight, not a clause.
